niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right partner depends on your objectives, budget, markets, creative needs, and whether you want programmatic scale or direct premium publisher access.

To help you choose, here’s a compact guide plus reputable firms and platforms by category, and what to ask when vetting partners.

What to consider first
- Objective: brand awareness, direct-response, footfall, or app installs?  
- Budget & flight length: minimum spends vary a lot.  
- Markets & inventory: U.S. vs global; premium publishers vs open programmatic.  
- Measurement needs: viewability, conversion attribution, deduplication across linear/CTV.  
- Creative: do you need dynamic creative, multiple aspect ratios, or production help?  
- Transparency: independent reporting, fees, access to billing/inventory details.

Top places to look (examples, not exhaustive)
- Large holding-group agencies (scale + cross-screen planning)
  - GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker, EssenceMediacom)
  - Omnicom (OMD, PHD)
  - Publicis (Zenith, Starcom)
  - Dentsu (Carat, Dentsu X)
  - IPG (Initiative, UM)

- Programmatic/tech-driven partners & DSPs
  - The Trade Desk (strong programmatic CTV capabilities)
  - Amobee (CTV + TV planning)
  - Simulmedia (linear + CTV optimization)
  - Magnite / Tremor / SpotX (SSP/CTV sellers that also have agency partnerships)
  - Roku OneView, Samsung Ads, VIZIO/ Inscape — platform-specific buying options

- CTV/OTT specialists and creative/measurement partners
  - Innovid (creative, dynamic video for CTV + measurement)
  - Cadent (audience targeting for TV/CTV)
  - TVSquared, DoubleVerify, IAS — measurement & verification partners
  - Independent agencies with CTV focus (many regional specialists and performance-driven shops)

What to ask when vetting an agency
- Which CTV inventory do you get (publisher direct, PMP, open exchange)?  
- How do you measure outcomes and attribution across CTV and linear? Which partners do you use?  
- Can you show case studies with similar KPIs and budgets? Can you provide references?  
- How do you manage frequency, duplication and audiences across screens?  
- Who produces creatives and handles optimization? Do you support dynamic creative?  
- Contract, fees and transparency: media markup, platform fees, reporting access?  
- Brand safety, fraud prevention, and viewability standards and vendors used.

If you want a shortlist tailored to you
Tell me: industry, target countries, monthly/total budget, main KPI (awareness vs performance), and whether you need creative production. I’ll recommend 3–5 agencies or partners that fit those constraints.
